basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III Recruitment 2026 – Walkin

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for the Project Nurse III post is 35 years.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | project nurse iii: BSc. Nursing with experience of working in labour room, maternity ward, neonatal care, and clinical research projects. And Registration with the State/Indian Nursing Council. Desirable: Candidates with prior experience of minimum 6 months in any govt. funded research project will be given preference.

salary_details.details: The salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits and it is based on experience, qualifications, skill set, etc. of the candidates.

selection_process: The selection process comprises a Screening/Scrutiny Test depending on the number of applicants
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format and prepare your bio-data.
Fill out the application form with all required details.
Gather all relevant original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies regarding age, qualifications, and relevant experience.
If working in Govt. or Public Sector undertaking, secure a No Objection Certificate (NOC) to produce at the interview.
Report in person for the Walk-In-Interview on 28/10/2026 between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM at the interview venue.
Submit the filled application form and documents during the reporting window at the designated venue.
important_instructions: Reporting time for candidates starts at 9:00 AM and the closing time to report for the interview is 10 AM on the same day, after which no additional candidates would be entertained. The posts are filled on purely on a temporary basis, co-terminus with the project, and candidates have no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS, Jodhpur. The tenure of the project is 7 months for recruitment of infants at birth, initially for 6 months and extendable every three to six-monthly based on work performance. No TA/DA will be admissible to appear in the interview. All educational, professional, and technical qualifications must be from a recognized Board/University and full-time. Experience requirement must be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications required for the post. Candidates should be prepared for flexible working hours.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: AIIMS Jodhpur has advertised for 1 temporary vacancy of Project Nurse - III under an ICMR-funded extramural research project in the Department of Neonatology.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Nurse - III?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Nurse - III post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 28/10/2026, with reporting time between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. Nursing degree with experience of working in a labour room, maternity ward, neonatal care, and clinical research projects, along with registration with the State/Indian Nursing Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for the Project Nurse - III post is 35 years.
